description: This file defines API endpoints for managing files in an OpenAI-like environment, including create, retrieve, delete, and list operations. It integrates with FastAPI, handles model-based routing, storage backends, and logging.

classes.name: CreateFileRequest
classes.description: Data structure representing a request to create/upload a file.

classes.name: FileExpiresAfter
classes.description: Data structure representing expiration parameters for a file.

classes.name: OpenAIFileObject
classes.description: Representation of a file object returned by the API.

classes.name: ProxyLogging
classes.description: Logging utility for proxy request tracking.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Authentication info for user API keys.

methods.name: set_files_config
methods.description: Sets the configuration for files, resolving environment variables.

methods.name: get_files_provider_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific LLM provider.

methods.name: get_first_json_object
methods.description: Extracts the first JSON object from file content bytes.

methods.name: get_model_from_json_obj
methods.description: Extracts model information from a JSON object.

methods.name: route_create_file
methods.description: Routes file creation requests to the appropriate backend or provider based on parameters.
